# gluetun post-rules for gate.home — applied inside the VPN client after the tunnel is up.
# Generated by kiwi-server; the fleet file is the place to change it.
# MTU: no TCP segment bigger than the tunnel carries — its MTU less 40 bytes of IPv4
# and TCP headers, on every SYN both ways. Not --clamp-mss-to-pmtu: it reads only the
# interface a SYN leaves by, and the way back can be narrower. --set-mss never raises
# a smaller MSS.
iptables -t mangle -A FORWARD -p tcp -m tcp --tcp-flags SYN,RST SYN -j TCPMSS --set-mss 1336
# forwarding (gluetun's policy is DROP): no hairpin on eth0; replies to what went out;
# what the DNAT rules below redirect; the docker network out through the tunnel.
iptables -A FORWARD -i eth0 -o eth0 -j REJECT
iptables -A FORWARD -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
iptables -A FORWARD -s 172.64.0.0/24 -o tun0 -j ACCEPT
# NAT: everything leaving through the tunnel
iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o tun0 -j MASQUERADE
# replies to what we sent out
iptables -A INPUT -i tun0 -m state --state RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
